Market today: The mood is cautious in tech, especially chips, driven by Nvidia's recent losing streak and concerns about chip 'leakage' to China. This directly impacts your concentrated book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-74.94%), MUU (-55.69%), and SPAL (-46.52%) are in deep drawdowns, amplified by margin and their leveraged nature. These need immediate attention.

Watch: Keep an eye on any further news regarding chip export restrictions and how the market reacts to the "data center slowdown overblown" narrative.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing your deeply underwater leveraged positions to protect your capital on margin.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting SOXL given the extreme -74.94% loss and its leveraged decay, especially with chip sector uncertainty.
MUU & SPAL: Review these leveraged positions, both down significantly, to assess if their stops are appropriate or if further trimming is warranted.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
